# VendorsDesk (https://vendorsdesk.in)

> VendorsDesk is India's #1 All-in-One Supplier Growth Suite for Meesho, Flipkart, and Amazon sellers.

## Core Features & Tools
- **Bulk AI Background Remover & Live Studio**: Automatically isolates product subjects (Kurti, Saree, Shoes, Bags, Watches) and replaces backgrounds with 12+ real studio scenes (Beach, Living Room, Palace, Garden) plus 19 PNG graphic badges (Best Seller, 100% Original, Free Shipping).
- **Free Catalog Image Generator**: Generates catalog variations with pink/blue borders and graphic stamps to bypass Meesho duplicate listing filters.
- **Shipping Rate & Freight Optimizer**: Audits product image dimensions against Meesho logistics matrices (₹48, ₹56, ₹62 slabs) to lower freight fees per unit.
- **Excel P&L Settlement Auditor**: Reconciles Meesho payment settlement sheets, customer returns, RTO penalties, TCS/TDS deductions, and bank payouts.
- **Bulk PDF Thermal Label Exporter**: Crops 4x6 thermal shipping labels from multi-page PDF manifests and auto-sorts packages by SKU.
